title: 车市需求降两成：小米电动车逆势上量，两款车型爬坡，凭什么撑住？
speaker: Yu Chen-Deng

segments.en: What about for the EV business, right? We're starting to see momentum really slow down when it comes to the wider China auto market.
segments.zh: 电动车业务呢？中国整体汽车市场的增长势头明显放缓。

segments.en: How does Xiaomi fare in that environment now? Yeah, so this year I would say, for Xiaomi lately, they've been doing really well.
segments.zh: 小米在这种环境下表现如何？今年小米一直做得很好。

segments.en: The two models from this kind of matter has been ramping up well. So corner on quarter into the fourth quarter, we do see a strong EV volume to support both on the volume
segments.zh: 这两款车型稳步上量，四季度环比来看，电动车销量强劲，支撑销量

segments.en: and also pricing as well as margin perspective.
We're not too worried for Xiaomi. But for the overall market, there's a different picture.
segments.zh: 我们对小米不太担心，但整体市场则是另一番景象。

segments.en: So this year's demand, here today, overall car market demand down by low 20%.
segments.zh: 今年的需求，整体汽车市场需求下降约20%。

segments.en: So EV is also down by low 10%. So it's one of the worst year we're having.
segments.zh: 电动车也下降约10%，是近年来表现较差的一年。

segments.en: So overall demand picture is not getting any better, but we do want to highlight when we sell into first quarter next year.
segments.zh: 整体需求未见好转，但我们要强调，明年一季度销售时

segments.en: The monthly, young year is going to improve. How do you look at international expansion now now that we have seen the likes of EU
segments.zh: 月度、年度数据将改善。国际扩张怎么看？欧盟等地已有所动作

segments.en: and we're talking about the US right now? I mean, obviously, they don't.
segments.zh: 现在又谈到美国？显然他们不会。

segments.en: Just have EV cars, the Chinese EV cars in the US, but we're talking about tariffs once again.
segments.zh: 美国市场仅有中国电动汽车，但关税问题再次被提及。

segments.en: Do you think they can rely on overseas expansion to offset maybe the weakness in domestically?
segments.zh: 你认为它们能依靠海外扩张来抵消国内市场的疲软吗？
